claim_policy: This configuration exercises the paper's named visual architecture and augmentation families and performs clean-validation loss-weight selection. It remains paper_protocol because the paper does not publish the 13-layer topology, augmentation parameters, validation metric, or unambiguous nU accounting.
known_gaps: The paper names a 13-layer CNN but does not publish its layer-by-layer topology; cnn13 is a documented clean-room adapter.
The paper names SimAugment and RandAugment but does not publish their parameters; crop, color, and RandAugment settings are explicit clean-room choices.

The paper reports nP=1000 and nU=50000 on a 50000-image CIFAR-10 training split while also reserving 10% clean validation. This disjoint runner uses 5000 clean validation examples plus 1000 P and 44000 U and records the protocol difference.
The paper does not identify the validation selection metric; validation accuracy is an explicit provisional choice.
The full 5-seed, 800-epoch CUDA experiment has not been executed.
